instruction_and_scoring.administration: Original open-resource project; 14-20 hours is an uncalibrated planning estimate. Independent implementation and initial decision precede reference-guide use. Memo maximum 1,200 words and oral defense ten minutes.
instruction_and_scoring.essential_floor: At least 15/20 in each domain and 85/100 overall, plus transfer/teach-back and remediation of critical errors; these are library design criteria.
instruction_and_scoring.grading: Transparent arithmetic errors carry through without repeated deductions; new conceptual errors are separately scored. Alternative recommendations can earn full credit after answering the original contract and specifying altered rights, funding and consequences.
instruction_and_scoring.critical_errors: Dates/currency location, duplicated resources or pledged collateral, deleted missed/written-off rights, double impairment, manufactured reserves, unfunded debt conversion, averaging obligations over scenarios, omitted pension deficit and altered evidence all trigger remediation.

ES is obtained by integrating the step quantile, not by reusing the reference tail filler.

limitations: Separate-agent review reduces error risk but is not external human certification or learner completion.
Only the finite declared policy and scenario contract, plus named transfers and boundary cases, was audited; no all-path solvency, strategic equilibrium or global optimum is established.
Actual external receipts, beneficiary delivery, title, authority and organizational effectiveness require evidence beyond these synthetic inputs.
Marked long bonds are retained assets, not automatically usable cash. Remaining pension bank claims are reconciled at face, not certified economic default recoveries.
The oral deposit-to-equity transfer intentionally changes rights outside the implemented baseline schema.
No whole-economy endowment audit, lifelong actuarial valuation, current-law verification, rendered browser/mobile/keyboard/print audit or full-volume acceptance is claimed.
Coordinator acceptance, assembly, shared regression and publishing remain the coordinator’s separate responsibility.
